info.title: Kira owner API
info.description: Owner-only API sharing the bot's handlers and knowledge. API dialogue is separate; background notifications use Telegram.

200.description: Supported formats and shared bot capability catalog
Recent API dialogue, oldest first; this is a bounded window, not a full archive
Active personal reminders from the shared registry
Up to 100 shared recurring tasks belonging to the owner

post.description: Runs the complete shared text/command flow. Retry the exact body with the same key after a connection loss. Does not cancel work when the client disconnects.

parameters.name: Prefer
parameters.description: Opt into a deferred answer. Without this header the complete answer is returned synchronously. Keep the same preference when replaying an Idempotency-Key.

503.description: model_mode_unavailable: the app's selected mode cannot run; refused before any receipt, so the request did not execute

post.description: Invoke a signed button from the latest API turn, within 15 minutes. The same token cannot execute twice, even with a different idempotency key.

503.description: model_mode_unavailable: the app's selected mode cannot run; refused before any receipt, so the request did not execute

get.description: Download a generated file, available for 24 hours. Authorization is required.

200.description: File bytes; Content-Disposition supplies the filename

get.summary: Get saved preferences, effective background state and personal Telegram availability

patch.summary: Atomically change budget mode and selected background functions; no Idempotency-Key required

schema.description: At least one changed setting is required. Missing fields keep their previous values. Enabling a feature does not grant Telegram access.

get.summary: The app's own text mode: catalog from the server preset registry with availability, this channel's selection and the global server preset

put.summary: Select a preset for this API channel only (null = as on the server). Compare-and-set on revision; applies from the next turn.

409.description: revision_conflict: the selection changed elsewhere; read it again

get.summary: AR scene capabilities: the photo model that reads a frame in the app's mode, frame limits, allowed actions

200.description: Capabilities: version, frame limits, actions, autoSeat (true: sit without targetId lets the phone choose the seat; results may name it), pointing (true: point actions and scene.things are accepted), mode, vision route; intentPlanning {version, intents, planTtlSeconds}: stage "prepare" decides by meaning whether a turn needs a frame; intentPlanning.controlOnly:true advertises nonexecuting control-only preparation.

post.summary: One AR turn of the app dialogue: the words go through the same handlers as /messages, an optional current JPEG frame (not stored) through the same recognition as /photos, with the scene as context. The reply is messages[] as for /messages; Kira may also propose actions on ids of the scene, which the phone checks, performs and reports.

followUp.description: This turn answers Kira's question about a thing she did not show yet (which one / a better view). Servers with pointing. With a frame and no other action chosen, the same thing is searched on the new frame with the words as the distinction.

plan.description: A prepared turn (stage "prepare") whose decision this execution uses; the execution's receipt is keyed by owner + plan and fingerprints the whole request. 409 plan_stale (expired, unknown after a restart, other words/room/follow-up/model mode/frame recipient), plan_superseded (newer words prepared in the same room), plan_cancelled; none of them ran anything

avoid.description: With a frame only: the previously shown thing's position on this frame (0–1). Context for the current request, not an unconditional exclusion: repeat keeps that thing, replacement excludes it, a new referent ignores the old exclusion.

stage.description: prepare: {stage, text, scene, followUp?} — no frame, plan or avoid, no Idempotency-Key, no receipt; returns {plan: {id, expiresAt, intent: chat|look|find|clarify|cancel, frame, referent?, vision}}. cancel: {stage, plan} — that plan can no longer be executed; or {stage, room: {roomId, coordinateSpaceId}} — every plan prepared or still preparing in that room is off. An older preparation finishing after a newer one (or after a room cancel) is refused with 409 plan_superseded. prepare accepts optional controlOnly:true when intentPlanning.controlOnly is advertised: a control decision with frame:false and executable:false, no generation/plan changes. Normal preparation returns executable:true. A frame for a nonvisual/cancel plan is refused with 400 unexpected_frame before any handler.

controlOnly.description: stage prepare only. Semantic control probe for an interjection: classifies with the same context but does not supersede or register an executable plan. Its plan has frame:false and executable:false; only a later explicit cancel request cancels the original. Its id cannot execute a turn.

200.description: messages, actions [{id, kind: sit|stand|approach|lookAtUser|point, targetId?, label?, at?, roomId, roomVersion}] (sit without targetId: the phone chooses the seat from its own LiDAR scan; point: at {x, y, box?} is the thing on the turn's frame, 0–1 from the picture's top left, found by the photo model of the app's mode and put into the room by the phone's own depth; without at, targetId is a remembered thing or a room object; several such things, a poor view or no such thing give no point), rejectedActions [{kind, reason, code?, label?}] (point codes: not_found, ambiguous, unsure, no_frame, no_label, unknown_target, one_at_a_time), seen? [{label, at}] (other small things on the frame, for the phone to remember), vision {used, provider, model, location}. With a frame, the body's choice and the search run before the answer, so the words say what the arm does or ask which one / for a better view.

502.description: vision_failed / scene_failed / scene_reply_invalid: nothing is answered as if seen

post.summary: What actually happened to an action Kira proposed; repeating the same report is harmless

targetId.description: For a sit without targetId: the object the phone chose (servers with autoSeat); for a point: the remembered thing shown (servers with pointing)

detail.description: The steps the phone actually did (servers with autoSeat or pointing)

get.description: Состояние и ответы для backgroundJob из /messages. Отображайте новое notice один раз, result — один раз по id; completed без result означает, что дополнение не требуется. Следующий пользовательский ход отменяет предыдущий разбор. Telegram-задачи здесь не возвращаются.

delete.summary: Остановить фоновый разбор в этом API-диалоге

200.description: Идемпотентная отмена; false если задача уже завершена или не принадлежит этому каналу.

get.summary: Предпочтения моделей и доступные варианты распределения

200.description: Общие настройки аккаунта, действующий план, подключения и доступность сочетаний

put.summary: Сохранить автоматическую стратегию по качеству и API либо Custom

400.description: Некорректные настройки или отсутствует подходящая модель

post.summary: Отправить одно фото владельца с необязательной подписью
post.description: Синхронно выполняет общий с Telegram конвейер фото в сессии api:<ownerId> и режиме приложения. Prefer: respond-async не применяется. Байты фото не сохраняются в истории, журналах или квитанциях; квитанция содержит только отпечаток тела и ответ. При обрыве повторить то же тело с тем же Idempotency-Key: завершённый ответ воспроизводится без повторного анализа. Ошибка анализа после начала хода возвращается текстом в messages[].

401.description: unauthorized: нужен токен владельца или аккаунта

409.description: conversation_busy: предыдущий ход выполняется; idempotency_conflict: ключ уже использован с другим телом; operation_uncertain: исход прежней попытки не подтверждён, повторять только прежний запрос

413.description: photo_too_large: JPEG больше 2000000 байт; body_too_large: JSON больше 3 MiB

415.description: unsupported_photo: требуется JPEG; unsupported_media_type: требуется application/json

503.description: vision_unavailable: модель не поддерживает фото или недоступна; отказ до создания квитанции

bearerAuth.description: Personal owner token; provision at setup, never embed in a distributed app.

Reply.description: Completed response or replayed durable receipt

Error.description: 400 invalid request; 401 unauthorized; 404 missing; 409 busy/conflict/uncertain; 410 expired action; 413 too large; 415 content type; 422 unsupported delivery; 429 rate limited; 500 internal error. Never automatically resubmit an uncertain operation using a new key.

Retry-After.description: Present for rate limiting and a busy conversation

backgroundJob.description: Продолжение ответа. Получайте состояние через GET /dialogue-jobs; повторный POST /messages вернёт первоначальную квитанцию.

id.description: Negative channel message ID. Upsert by ID when replaying receipts.

text.description: May be absent for markup-only edits; preserve the original text.

fileUrl.description: Relative authorized API file path or external HTTP(S) media URL. Do not forward the owner token to external URLs.

scope.description: The selection applies only to this API channel; Telegram and background work keep the server preset

runsLocally.description: Conversation runs on the server's LM Studio, not on the client

cloudFallback.description: false for provider-pure presets: no silent cross-provider fallback

Scene.description: The phone's confirmed room now: metres, Y up, ARKit world of coordinateSpaceId. Walls stay on the phone.

observedAt.description: within 120 s of the server clock

things.description: Things Kira saw lying in this room before (servers with pointing): names, when, and the furniture they lay on or near; no coordinates

text.description: Необязательная подпись: после trim от 1 до 8000 символов.

data.description: Base64 JPEG: после декодирования не больше 2000000 байт, начало FF D8 FF. JSON-запрос ограничен 3 MiB.

notes.example: Фото анализируется один раз и не сохраняется; в историю попадает только текст.
